name: Meum Crypto Payments for WooCommerce
author: Meum

sections.description:
Accept crypto payments. Receive stablecoin settlement directly to your wallet.

Meum adds crypto payments to WooCommerce. Customers pay with supported crypto assets, while you receive settlement in the supported USD stablecoin configured for your settlement wallet.

As soon as payment is confirmed, the settlement amount is sent directly to that wallet. Meum does not hold your settlement funds.

Why merchants choose Meum

  • Accept 118 network and asset combinations across 25 blockchain networks
  • Receive settlement in the supported stablecoin configured for your wallet
  • Direct-to-wallet settlement after payment confirmation
  • Automatic WooCommerce order updates through signed webhooks
  • Compatible with WooCommerce Checkout Blocks
  • Free plugin with fast setup using a one-time connection key

How it works

  1. The customer selects Pay with Crypto at checkout.
  2. The customer is redirected to Meum Hosted Checkout.
  3. The customer pays with a supported crypto asset.
  4. Meum confirms the payment and sends a signed webhook to WooCommerce.
  5. WooCommerce updates the order, and settlement is sent to your configured wallet.

Before you begin, you need an active WooCommerce store, a Meum merchant account, and a wallet for receiving settlement.

Supported networks and assets

Meum currently supports the following networks and assets:

  • Aptos: APT, USDC, USDT
  • Arbitrum: ARB, ETH, GMX, SWEAT, USDC, USDT0, WETH
  • Avalanche: AVAX, USDC, USDT
  • Base: BRETT, ETH, KAITO, SWEAT, TITN, USDC, VVV, WETH
  • Berachain: BERA, USDT0
  • Bitcoin: BTC, BTC (Omni)
  • Bitcoin Cash: BCH
  • BNB Chain: ASTER, BNB, EVAA, NEAR, RHEA, SWEAT, USDC, USDT
  • Cardano: ADA
  • Dash: DASH
  • Dogecoin: DOGE
  • Ethereum: AAVE, ADI, AURORA, DAI, ETH, HAPI, INX, KNC, LINK, MOG, PEPE, SAFE, SHIB, SPX, SWEAT, TURBO, UNI, USD1, USDC, USDT, WBTC, WETH, XAUT
  • Gnosis: COW, GNO, SAFE, USDC, USDT, WETH
  • Litecoin: LTC
  • NEAR: AURORA, BLACKDRAGON, BTC, ETH, FRAX, HAPI, ITLX, JAMBO, NPRO, PUBLIC, RHEA, SHITZU, SWEAT, TURBO, USDC, USDT, wBTC, ZEC
  • Optimism: ETH, OP, USDC, USDT, WETH
  • Polygon: POL, USDC, USDT, WETH
  • Scroll: ETH, USDT
  • Solana: $WIF, BOME, MELANIA, PENGU, PUBLIC, SOL, SPX, TRUMP, TURBO, USD1, USDC, USDT, ZEC
  • Stellar: USDC, XLM
  • Sui: SUI, USDC
  • TON: USDT
  • TRON: TRX, USDT
  • XRP Ledger: XRP
  • Zcash: ZEC

This list reflects the current Meum Platform catalog and may change as payment routes are added or updated.

External services

This plugin connects to Meum Platform services to link your store, create payment invoices, host checkout, confirm payments, send order-status webhooks, and process settlement.

Meum Platform API

Used when connecting or testing the store, creating payment invoices, and verifying the integration.

Data sent may include the store URL, webhook URL, WordPress, WooCommerce and plugin versions, API credentials, order ID, order number, total, currency, customer ID, billing contact and address details, and return URL.

Meum Merchant Admin

Used when a merchant opens pages for integrations, settlement wallets, custom domains, or account settings. These pages open directly in the merchant’s browser.

Meum Hosted Checkout

Used when a customer is redirected to complete payment. It receives the invoice and payment-session data required to display and process checkout.

Inbound webhooks

Meum sends signed HTTP POST requests to the WooCommerce webhook endpoint. Data received may include the event type, invoice ID, order reference, payment amounts, status, and transaction metadata.

All Meum services are governed by the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

No affiliate, promotional, or powered-by links are added to your storefront without your action.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Meum Crypto Payments for WooCommerce.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Meum Crypto Payments.
  3. Sign in to Meum Merchant Admin.
  4. Open Integrations → WooCommerce and generate a one-time connection key.
  5. Paste the key into the plugin settings and connect your store.
  6. Configure your settlement wallet in Meum Merchant Admin.
  7. Enable the payment method and save your settings.
  8. Place a test order before accepting live payments.

For step-by-step instructions, see the WooCommerce installation guide.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

Yes. The WooCommerce plugin is free and does not require a paid plugin license. Payment processing and blockchain network fees may apply.

Do I need a Meum account?

Yes. Merchants need a Meum account to connect their store and configure a settlement wallet.

Where is settlement sent?

As soon as payment is confirmed, the settlement amount is sent directly to the wallet configured in Meum Merchant Admin, using the supported stablecoin and network selected for that wallet. Meum does not hold your settlement funds.

Are WooCommerce orders updated automatically?

Yes. Meum sends signed webhooks to update orders when a payment is paid, failed, expired, or underpaid.

What payment method do customers see at checkout?

Customers normally see Pay with Crypto at checkout. Meum Crypto Payments is the payment method name shown in WooCommerce administration.

Does the plugin support WooCommerce Checkout Blocks?

Yes. The plugin supports WooCommerce Checkout Blocks.

Can I use a custom Meum Platform API URL?

Yes. Advanced settings allow a custom Meum Platform API URL for staging or self-hosted environments. Production stores should normally use the default Meum Platform API.

Can I use my own checkout domain?

Custom checkout domains are a Meum Platform feature configured in Meum Merchant Admin, not in the WordPress plugin. Availability and setup options are shown in your Meum account.

Where can I get help?

Read the WooCommerce installation guide or use the WordPress.org support forum.
sections.changelog:
0.2.7

  • Hybrid Policy D WooCommerce order status mapping for Meum webhooks.
  • Expired unpaid attempts map to failed (retry-friendly); cancelled only for cancel events.
  • Post-paid refunds mirror via wc_create_refund with refund_payment=false.
  • Stale/missing active invoice soft-ignore (HTTP 200) with structured order notes.
  • Allow WooCommerce order-pay retry while Meum orders are on-hold (awaiting crypto payment).

0.2.6

  • Updated plugin documentation and screenshot captions for WordPress.org.

0.2.5

  • Initial release.
  • Added crypto payments through Meum Hosted Checkout.
  • Added direct-to-wallet settlement after payment confirmation.
  • Added store connection using a one-time connection key.
  • Added automatic WooCommerce order updates through signed webhooks.
  • Added WooCommerce Checkout Blocks support.
  • Added an advanced custom API URL option.
